connection_condition: yearmonth.CustomerID corresponds to customers.CustomerID; every monthly record carries a customer identifier and no record exists without a matching customer
description: A customer is composed of one monthly consumption record per reporting month; a monthly record has no meaning apart from the customer it is recorded for.

connection_condition: transactions_1k.CardID is always accompanied by exactly one transactions_1k.CustomerID for that card
description: Cards belong to a customer; in the observed transactions every card is used by exactly one customer, while a customer may use up to 17 distinct cards.

connection_condition: transactions_1k.CustomerID corresponds to customers.CustomerID; all 517 observed values resolve to customers
description: A customer is composed of the transaction lines recorded in its name; a line without its customer record loses attribution.

connection_condition: gasstations.ChainID groups gas stations; each station carries exactly one chain number and the largest chain covers 1462 of 5716 stations
description: A chain is composed of its member stations; the chain is expressed only through the ChainID value on stations, with no separate chain table.

connection_condition: transactions_1k.GasStationID corresponds to gasstations.GasStationID; all 437 observed values resolve to stations
description: A transaction line is located at the gas station recorded on it, so line-level results can be described by the station's chain, country and segment.

connection_condition: transactions_1k.ProductID corresponds to products.ProductID; the 28 distinct observed values all resolve to products
description: Each transaction line records the sale of one product, so line quantities and values can be grouped by product description.

connection_condition: customers.Segment partitions the customer set; the KAM, LAM and SME groups are disjoint and together contain all 32461 customers
description: Each recorded segment is a subcategory of customer, so the customers in any one segment form a subset of all customers.

connection_condition: gasstations.Segment partitions the station set; the five observed site categories together contain all 5716 stations
description: Each recorded site category is a subcategory of gas station, so stations in one category form a subset of all stations.

connection_condition: band membership is decided by the numeric ProductID range, so each band contains a disjoint subset of the products table
description: A product in a catalog band is a subtype of product; the two bands are disjoint subsets of the catalog.

connection_condition: transactions_1k.CustomerID and yearmonth.CustomerID draw on the same customer identifier set; all 517 transaction customer identifiers also appear in yearmonth
description: The two columns express the same customer reference concept in different tables, so a customer found through transactions can be followed into the monthly panel and the reverse.

connection_condition: line values and monthly consumption meet only through the customer identifier and the reporting period, with no shared key and no declared conversion
description: Both concepts describe amounts attributed to a customer in a period, but they are recorded at different grains and over different scopes, so their magnitudes are not interchangeable.

connection_condition: derived as the line value divided by the matching line quantity
description: The implied unit value is computed from the recorded line value and is defined only where the line quantity is greater than zero.

connection_condition: line quantity is the divisor of the derivation and must be greater than zero
description: The implied unit value depends on the line quantity as its divisor, so zero-quantity lines have no implied unit value.

connection_condition: derived by dividing the month total of Consumption by the number of distinct customers recorded in the same month
description: Average consumption per customer is derived from the monthly consumption totals together with the monthly customer coverage.

connection_condition: derived by counting distinct CustomerID values within each reporting month
description: Month customer coverage is derived from the monthly records by counting the customers present in each month.

connection_condition: the reporting month is one component of the record identity pair (Date, CustomerID)
description: Each monthly consumption record is stamped with exactly one reporting month, which is what makes month-over-month comparison possible.
